mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.0% signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate below 4.0% signals a tight labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 1250 thousand units indicate strong consumer demand for housing, signaling economic expansion and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1250.

mechanism_narrative: High industrial production (INDPRO > 105.0) reflects robust manufacturing activity, supporting corporate profits and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI index above 250 indicates elevated inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates, which compresses equity valuations and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 250.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in housing starts (HOUST > 1250) and retail sales (RSAFS > 500000) signals broad-based consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST > 1250 and RSAFS > 500000.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5%), the Federal Reserve typically implements monetary easing, reducing borrowing costs and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong retail sales (RSAFS > 490000) indicate robust consumer spending, supporting corporate revenue growth and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS > 490000.
